title: You Are My Energy
scene: Late-1980s Italian Italo disco and melodic synth-pop

title: No Way Out

title: Matter of Time
scene: Early-1990s European studio pop with dance and ballad arrangements
notes: Melancholy ballads and dance-pop integrate credited drum programming, piano, guitars and saxophone.

title: Siamo in due
scene: Mid-1990s Italian melodic pop and Sanremo

title: Lupi solitari
scene: 1990s Italian melodic pop and soft rock

title: Indivisibili

title: Domani
scene: Italian pop with Latin and orchestral crossover (Sanremo 2000)
